messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-04-15] standup/dune/2025-04-15: If image-resizer is down, the product catalog is down: it relies on it for thumbnails.
- [2025-12-01] handover/2025-12-01-image-resizer: The resizer has a new home: the Dune team. Ember kept it until today.
- [2026-03-03] standup/dune/2026-03-03: Image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only. Rationale: storage for originals doubled in six months.
- [2025-04-29] handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer: The Ember team is taking over the image resizer from team Dune, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20: The resizer lives with Dune.
- [2025-05-19] standup/cinder/2025-05-19-2: Team Cinder noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-04-04] standup/dune/2025-04-04: We agreed today that the catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table. The reason is that the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.
- [2025-07-03] standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2: Atlas saw that the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change; not their service, so they flagged it. The Atlas team noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-12-17] standup/dune/2025-12-17: Decided in today's standup: search-indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, since incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.
- [2025-06-23] standup/cinder/2025-06-23: Observation from the Cinder team: after the retention change, the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent.
- [2026-03-04] standup/dune/2026-03-04: The webhook dispatcher remains a team Dune service.
- [2025-04-08] standup/cinder/2025-04-08: Reminder that the indexer depends on the catalog.
- [2026-03-10] standup/dune/2026-03-10-2: Observation from team Dune: after Tuesday's deploy, the reporting service's p99 latency doubled. The webhook dispatcher deploy window (unchanged): on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-05-23] standup/ember/2025-05-23: The Ember team saw that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-04-18] standup/atlas/2025-04-18-2: Heads-up from the Atlas team: the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.
- [2026-01-01] standup/cinder/2026-01-01: The Cinder team noticed that the search indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-02-28] standup/cinder/2025-02-28: Dependency map update: search-indexer needs the product catalog (product documents). Cinder holds planning on Mondays.
- [2025-05-08] standup/boreal/2025-05-08: Boreal saw that the catalog's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-08-29] standup/atlas/2025-08-29: Observation from Atlas: after the client rollout, the product catalog's request volume halved.
- [2026-03-19] standup/ember/2026-03-19-2: Team Ember noticed that the job scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2026-03-31] standup/ember/2026-03-31: Diego Alvarez has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Oskar. Ember saw that the feature flag service's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-10-13] standup/cinder/2025-10-13: The monthly cost review is run by Yuki. Reminder that the search indexer depends on the catalog.
- [2025-06-12] standup/dune/2025-06-12: The Dune team noticed that the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners. Dune sits on the fourth floor.
- [2025-08-27] standup/cinder/2025-08-27: The search indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11; the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. Cinder sits on the third floor.
- [2026-02-12] standup/ember/2026-02-12: Ember on-call swapped this morning. Oskar carries the phone until the next rotation. Heads-up from team Ember: the search indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.

Question: Which service does image-resizer depend on?
